Synopsis:
    Motiva and Exxon are taking precautionary measures at their East Texas refineries (Port Arthur, Beaumont, Baytown) ahead of Tropical Depression 5, expected to make landfall near Port Arthur on Tuesday as Tropical Storm Edouard. No production cuts have occurred yet. LNG operators Cheniere and Freeport LNG are monitoring the situation. The storm is not forecast to reach hurricane strength, with max winds of 58 mph. Significant refining capacity is potentially at risk, including Motiva's 656,400 bpd (largest US refinery), Exxon's Beaumont (612,000 bpd) and Baytown (564,000 bpd), and Valero's 235,000 bpd Port Arthur refinery.
